description: SIMULATED. pymodbus 3.16.1 server on 127.0.0.2:502 (eval/sim/modbus_server.py, single context = answers every unit id); eval/sim/modbus_fc43_query.py reads FC43 basic+regular for unit 1 and then unit 2 (gateway-style ids).

capture.method: Npcap loopback capture via eval/sim/capture_lo.py, converted to Ethernet by eval/sim/sim_lab.py convert
capture.notes: Identity from eval/sim/modbus_server.py: VendorName Schneider Electric, ProductCode TM221CE16R, MajorMinorRevision V1.6.2.0 (+ regular objects 0x03-0x05). pymodbus single=True context answers ALL unit ids with the same identity, so u1/u2 are a simulated gateway case (same values, two unit ids), not two distinct devices. MACs are synthetic (02:00:00:00:00:<last IP octet>): the Npcap loopback capture (link type 0) has no Ethernet header, so eval/sim/sim_lab.py convert rewrote each frame as Ethernet. Identity values come from the simulator config, not real hardware. Reproduce: eval/sim/RECORD.md.

source.vendor: client scripts eval/sim/*_query.py on the same PC; no identity
Modbus TCP endpoint answering 2 unit ids; no unit 0/255 identity read, so the endpoint itself has no identity
